name: Realm Defense: Hero Legends TD
storyline: Dark forces threaten the kingdoms of the realm, and only the bravest defenders can stop them. From frozen tundras to enchanted sky realms, players must lead heroes and towers against monstrous hordes and powerful bosses. As the campaign unfolds, uncover the origins of legendary characters and unite fractured lands to restore balance.
summary: A vibrant tower defense strategy game where players command legendary heroes and powerful towers to repel invading forces. With over 300 levels across multiple realms, Realm Defense challenges your tactical prowess in campaign missions, endless waves, and competitive tournaments. Recruit iconic characters like Fee the Archer and Smoulder the Dragon, customize their abilities, and rise to glory in this epic fantasy adventure.
